Body.Content:
The write to business rules engine configuration experience introduces an option to submit only records that have successfully passed Account structure validation. When enabled, Business Performance Planning filters the writeback dataset and submits only records marked as valid by account structure validation to the business rules engine writeback process. Records that have not passed validation are excluded from the submission so users can review and correct them before attempting to write them to Dynamics 365 Finance.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/business-performance-planning/bpp-bud-reg-write

GA date: November CY2026
